mapper.select: SELECT b.id, b.bill_no, b.owner_id, o.owner_name, o.owner_phone, b.house_id, h.house_number, bd.building_name, c.community_name, b.fee_item_id, f.item_name, f.item_code, b.bill_period, b.bill_amount, b.paid_amount, b.status, b.pay_deadline, b.pay_time, b.pay_method, b.create_time, b.update_time FROM bill_info b LEFT JOIN owner_info o ON b.owner_id = o.id AND o.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN house_info h ON b.house_id = h.id AND h.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN building_info bd ON h.building_id = bd.id AND bd.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN community_info c ON bd.community_id = c.id AND c.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN fee_item f ON b.fee_item_id = f.id AND f.is_deleted = 0 WHERE b.id = #{billId} AND b.is_deleted = 0
